doc: The ONE movement and feel tuning file (owner 11-08), read by scripts/core/locomotion.gd (Loco) for the farm avatar and every match hunter alike. Live: with the movement readout open (F7, or Settings > Controls), saving this file re-reads it within poll_s. Units: m, s, m/s, m/s^2; drags are 1/s (the share of the excess lost per second, exponential). air: accel = how hard WASD pushes in the air; counter = multiplier on accel for the part of your speed going against the keys (a backward drift turns forward in ~0.1 s); side = multiplier for the part going across the keys (bends the arc); drag = how fast speed above your run cap (dash, knock, launch) bleeds in the air; idle_drag = what a jump with no keys loses per second. glide (the pull toward where you steer is [game data], HunterMove.glide_accel): turn / turn_fast = deg/s at cruise and the share kept at the max; brake / brake_deg = pulling back past this angle brakes this hard; drag = how fast speed above cruise bleeds with no keys (back to cruise in ~1.5 s), drag_steer = the same while steering; coast = m/s^2 a let-go under cruise slows; catch = m/s^2 the canopy eases a fall to its sink rate (absorbed, never turned into speed; ours: the source clamps the fall the step the glider opens, HunterMove.glide_start_vy, and its fastest-fall half is locked); max = the fastest a glide carries. glide_carry: per hunter, speed above this carried from Shift into a glide bleeds at carry_drag (on top of drag), so a dash never turns into a long sprint. dash.jump_keep: the share of a ground dash's speed a jump out of it keeps (the rest is air drag's, Loco.air_step; 1 = all of it, a long dash-jump). dash_speed: per hunter, a dash's speed scale (its time stretches so the distance stays); the shape of a dash (ease in, peak, skid) is the hunter's source curve in content/rules/dash_feel.json. hunter, dash and physics (moved here from the Hunter consts and hunter_move.json, feel-tuning-consts; no number changed): every key has a note in its section's notes, tagged by where it comes from: [D] game data, [F] footage, [O] owner call. hunter: jump_v m/s a jump leaves the ground with, gravity m/s^2 (up and down), glide_speed m/s a glider's cruise, glide_sink m/s its steady fall, ledge_air_accel m/s^2 steering on a ledge rise. dash: speed, time, regen (s per charge) of the base dash, ex_cd s of the long dash, buffer s a Shift pressed early waits, ex_time_mul and ex_dist (m) the long dash's time (x the base time) and reach when the class sets none (the farm's, and a match hunter's time). physics: HunterMove's ground stop, dash exit, fall, glide, dive and mantle tunables for every hunter (read once at start, not live); hunter_move.json keeps the per-hunter speed and accel rows.

notes.jump_v: [D] JumpZVelocity 7.5 m/s; ours 6.8 so jump + mantle tops out under four of our 0.8 m terraces [O]
notes.gravity: [D] DefaultGravityZ -1470 uu/s^2, the same up and down
notes.glide_speed: [D] MaxGlide 500 uu/s; item 163 'too fast and controllable' [O]
notes.glide_sink: [F] one steady sink whatever the speed; 1.4 is floatier than the source read of 2-4 m/s [O]
notes.ledge_air_accel: [O] a ledge rise steers crisply (a jump steers by air.accel)

notes.jump_keep: [O] the share of a ground dash's speed a jump out of it keeps
notes.speed: [O] the base dash 19 m/s x 0.19 s = 3.6 m (23 felt too fast)
notes.regen: [O] seconds to win back one dash charge
notes.ex_cd: [F] the long dash's cooldown: in the air, or with the short one on cooldown
notes.buffer: [O] a Shift pressed this long early fires as the move ends
notes.ex_time_mul: [O] the long dash lasts this many base dash times when the class sets no ex_time
notes.ex_dist: [O] the farm's long dash reach in m when the class sets no ex_dist (a match hunter's is speed x time)

notes.brake: [D] BrakingDecelerationWalking 2220 uu/s^2, m/s^2: the constant part of the walking stop
notes.ground_friction: [D] GroundFriction 1.0 x BrakingFrictionFactor 2, 1/s: the share of speed a let-go sheds per second (a run stops in ~0.17 s, ~0.3 m)
notes.dash_exit_run: [O] a dash ends at this share of run speed (never faster than the dash); the data has no hard stop and the exit curves are not decoded
notes.abyss_fall_cap: [D] the fall cap over the abyss, reached at abyss_slow_to
notes.abyss_slow_from: [D] AbyssFallSlowDistMin, m under an island lip where the fall starts easing
notes.abyss_slow_to: [D] AbyssFallSlowDistMax, m under the lip where the fall reaches abyss_fall_cap
notes.glide_height: [D] GlideDownwardForceHeightTarget, m: above it the glider pulls you down
notes.glide_pull_vy: [D] GlideDownwardForceMinZVelocity, m/s: the pull's fall speed (never turned into speed, owner 11-08)
notes.glide_accel: [D] GlideTargetXYForce 162500 over Mass 100, m/s^2: the glider's pull toward where you steer
notes.glide_start_vy: [D] GlideStartFallSpeedMin, m/s: the slowest fall the step the glider opens (the matching Max is locked, see glide.catch)
notes.turn_rate: [D] RotationRate yaw, deg/s: the body turns to the cursor at a fixed rate
notes.mantle_vy_cap: [D] MantleSuctionUpwardsForceZSpeedCap, m/s: the suction pulls only while you rise slower than this
notes.mantle_pull: [D] MantleSuctionUpwardsForceMax over Mass 100, m/s^2 (the distance curve that scales it is not decoded: the max is used throughout)
notes.mantle_launch_keep: [D] MiniMantleXYSpeedTargetCoefficient: the share of run speed onto a ledge you climb
notes.mantle_launch_min: [D] MiniMantleXYSpeedTargetMin, m/s: at least this onto a ledge
notes.dive_vy: [D] GlideDiveZTargetSpeed, m/s: the plunge speed while crouch is held under the glider
notes.dive_accel: [D] GlideDiveZForceMax over Mass, m/s^2: how fast the plunge speeds up
notes.dive_steer: [D] GlideDiveXYForceMultiplier: the share of the glide's steering the keys keep in the plunge
notes.dive_cancel_h: [D] GlideDiveCancelDistance, m above the ground where the plunge ends and the glide catches you
notes.dive_timeout: [D] GlideDiveTimeout, s of holding before the plunge ends on its own
